findings.text: Offers inline call sites that can be rewritten at boot from feature flags, with one replacement and two replacement forms plus a ternary chooser between yes and no sequences, all accepting caller outputs inputs and clobbers while preserving call constraint handling for the stack pointer.
Provides a helper to emit a globally visible aligned assembly routine with function type and size in a caller chosen executable section, including branch protection and return handling.

Alternative rewriting keeps the original byte sequence inline, pads length differences with no operation bytes, records a descriptor with original location and replacement location plus feature flag and both lengths in a dedicated instructions section, and stores the replacement bytes with a data annotation in a separate executable replacement section.
Classic IBS data source identifiers are small integers with local cache two and DRAM three and remote cache four and IO seven.

Extended IBS data source identifiers are small integers with local cache one and near CCX cache two and DRAM three and far CCX cache five and persistent memory six and IO seven and extended memory eight and peer agent memory twelve.

Fetch sampling control is a sixty four bit value also viewed as fields for max count and current count and latency in the low half, enable and valid and complete and cache miss near the middle, address validity and TLB page size and TLB misses above that, then random tagging and level two miss and level three only and op cache miss and level three miss with two reserved top bits.

Op sampling control is a sixty four bit value with periodic max count low, level three only and enable and valid and counter control in the teens, extended max count upper bits in the twenties, a reserved gap, current counter across the middle high range, and load latency threshold plus enable at the very top.

Op sample status packs completion to retire and tag to retire counts in the low thirty two bits, with return and taken branch and mispredict and retired branch and invalid RIP and fused branch and microcode indicators above, and a large reserved upper field.
Second op word encodes data source split across low and higher bits, destination node, cache hit state, streaming store and remote socket flags, with most high bits reserved.

Third op word distinguishes load versus store, TLB miss and large page hit conditions, cache miss and misalignment, write combining and uncacheable and locked and no buffer allocation cases, address validity, level two miss, software prefetch, access width, outstanding request count, miss latency and TLB refill latency in the upper half.
Fetch extended control carries ITLB refill latency in the low sixteen bits with the upper forty eight bits reserved.

Performance IBS transfer object starts with a size, followed by a union that is either a flexible data array or a capabilities word, then a fixed array of raw register values sized by the architectural maximum count.

AMD northbridge description groups a bus and device base and limit triple, an L3 descriptor with index count and four subcache entries, a per node pair of PCI devices plus L3 details, and a global table with count and flags and pointer to per node entries.
AMD northbridge feature flags occupy the low three bits for GART and L3 index disable and L3 partitioning, maximum AMD nodes per system is eight, and node zero lives at PCI slot hex 0x18.

When hardware support is absent the HSMP send and SMN read and write and combined read write helpers report device absence without side effects, a single register reader forwards node zero requests to the SMN reader and propagates errors, and the AMD node count is the product of nodes per package and maximum packages.

GART presence is affirmed only on AMD parts within the older families and early models of the newer family, otherwise denied; when northbridge support is compiled out the node count and feature test collapse to zero and false and node lookup yields null and GART presence is false.

APIC build reports timer stops in C3 as one, external NMI routing as zero for BSP and one for all and two for none, verbosity as zero quiet and one verbose and two debug, invalid ACPI ID as maximum unsigned thirty two bit value, and C2 timer OK as one.

APIC logging emits only when requested verbosity does not exceed global verbosity, with convenience forms for verbose and debug and continued debug plus an unconditional debug form; interrupt mode is one of five wirings from legacy PIC through virtual wire variants to symmetric IO variants, and SMP derived configuration requires found SMP tables without APIC disable.

Memory mapped APIC writes target base plus register offset with an erratum aware choice of store primitive, reads use the generic memory mapped reader, and end of interrupt is signaled by writing the acknowledge value to the EOI offset.

MSR based APIC writes ignore destination format and identity and version registers and otherwise address base MSR plus register shifted down by four, reads return all ones for destination format and otherwise return the low half of the corresponding MSR, EOI uses a direct acknowledge write, and ICR access packs target ID high with low control word for sixty four bit transfer.

x2APIC is considered enabled only when the CPU feature is present and the APIC base MSR enable bit reads set through a fault safe read; one build derives setup and enabled and supported queries from that test while the fallback build makes setup empty and enabled false and supported false and mode zero.

APIC operation tables collect end of interrupt, register read and write, ICR idle waits, several IPI fanouts, destination calculation, ICR access, probe and setup and teardown and ACPI checks, logical destination init, presence mapping, ID translation, thirty two and sixty four bit secondary wakeups, vector updates and a name, with flags for ESR disable and logical destination and max ID handling and offline NMI; an override table mirrors the hotpath and IPI and ICR and wakeup subset.

Driver registration places a pointer to each APIC implementation in a dedicated drivers section with suitable alignment, and per callback static call declarations are generated from the active APIC operation.

Register access offers fault safe sixty four bit reads that return an error status and always store a value with optional tracing, plain writes with optional tracing, and paravirtual variants that indirect through CPU operation vectors for both safe read and write.

Fault safe register read emits a labeled read sequence plus a fallthrough label and appends an exception table entry carrying both addresses with a safe read type and the error register binding in a sized mergeable section.

Without APIC support many lifecycle helpers become empty or constant covering probe and force enable and clustered box test and shutdown and mappings and disable and clock setup and frequency update and BSP init and mode select and init and vector assignment and topology limits and possible CPU init, while PIT need reports true.

MSR APIC path silently drops writes to selected identification registers and synthesizes all ones for destination format reads, so callers cannot rely on round trip there; the no x2APIC build treats an MSR read as a fatal bug rather than returning data.
